title: Review of Community Feedback on the City Manager Candidates
notes: Mayor Anderson reviewed the community input and described how a City Manager candidate would be selected at the 7:00 p.m. Business Meeting. Vice Mayor Hess thanked participants, Pamela Wideman of Raftelis, and staff; Commissioner Praedel spoke about the three candidates (per minutes). The minutes title this "Review of Community Input and the Candidate Selection Process".
